remarks: Welcome to 9 Apache Place in Riverside, CT! This beautifully renovated home has been completely and meticulously updated, offering a perfect blend of modern comfort and classic charm. Featuring 4 spacious bedrooms, this home also boasts a first-floor office, ideal for remote work or as a quiet retreat, not included in the bedroom count.  The backyard and deck provide ample space for outdoor entertaining and relaxation-whether you're enjoying a summer barbecue or simply unwinding in the fresh air. During the colder months, cozy up to the fireplace in the living room, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.  The finished basement offers even more space, perfect for a home gym, recreation area, or additional storage.
